text:
sam (oncall): Morning async — quick standup. SLO: embeddings eu-west 99.9% target slipped to ~99.4% overnight. Noticed a short 503 spike around 02:18 UTC. Filed INC-2026 and started initial triage.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026 created and assigned to sam (oncall) — 2026-02-14T02:20:13Z
jia: I see the spike in the request histogram. Autoscaler didn't react fast enough; queue backlog hit ~5k at 02:16.
liam: looking into nodepool events now. Running: `rctl autoscale events --region eu-west --since 3h` to pull scale history.
priya: I pushed the batching autoscaler fix yesterday (PR #3427). It merged but IIRC the canary failed on one host class. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rex/pull/3427
sam (oncall): @priya correct — merge went through but canary pods hit a crashloop: `init failed: failed to attach nvme` on a subset of hosts. I manually restarted canary and the canary pod stabilized.
jia: short mitigation idea: bump batcher replicas to 4 and lower max_batch_wait to 20ms for eu-west temporarily until autoscaler behaviour looks stable. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
liam: +1. I'll queue a canary bump to replicas=4, max_wait=20ms, observe for 30m then promote. Will monitor p50/p95.
priya: FYI the nvme attach issue traces to a kernel/driver mismatch on older host class — ops ticket TICK-778 created for infra patch.
nora (eng-sre): TICK-778 assigned to eng-infra, tagging @liam to coordinate host remediation.
sam (oncall): Runbook short-term step proposal: fallback to cpu-pool when GPU attach fails. I'll draft the snippet below.
sam (oncall): Draft runbook snippet:
```
# fallback to cpu when GPU pool spin fails
rctl route set --model embedding-v2 --pool cpu-fallback --priority low
```
liam: +1 on the runbook addition. Good to have explicit fallback to keep latency bounded.
jia: small side ask — PR 3450 adjusts alerting to reduce noise from transient 5xxs. Can people review it before EOD? It's low-risk but needs two approvals.
priya: will review after deployment confirmation for the canary bump.
liam: incident timeline note: INC-2026 -> resolved at 03:12 UTC after canary restart + replicas bump. Will write a short postmortem.
sam (oncall): Blockers: eng-infra confirmation on nvme host patch (TICK-778), priya to confirm PR3450 review, jia to update SLO dashboard baselines (I can help with numbers).
nora (eng-sre): I've created the async postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/incidents/INC-2026 — please add notes and action items.
sam (oncall): I'll close this thread once postmortem link and action items are in. Ping here if you want handover tonight.
priya: assigning followups and action items to TICK-778; will attach kernel version matrix.
jia: updating dashboards now and will comment here when done. :white_check_mark:
liam: watching eu-west for next 6h. Will escalate immediately if we see new 5xx cluster.
sam (oncall): Thanks all :thumbsup:
